title: 10.3 Top-1% behaviours (these are the actual differentiators)
description: Roadmap 10.3 — 8 topics, in the document's own order.
learningOutcomes: Take every topic in this section to pass 3 of the roadmap's rule: intuition, then derived on paper, then implemented from scratch.

lessons.title: Write publicly — one substantial technical post per month, minimum. Depth beats frequency.
learningObjectives: Pass 1 — watch or read for intuition, and accept the confusion

lessons.title: Ship open source — a genuinely useful package with real users beats 20 tutorial repos. (Your text-to-SQL safety package is a strong candidate; harden it and promote it.)
learningObjectives: Pass 1 — watch or read for intuition, and accept the confusion

lessons.title: Reproduce and extend papers publicly
learningObjectives: Pass 1 — watch or read for intuition, and accept the confusion

lessons.title: Build things that solve real business problems, not chatbot demos — you already believe this; keep it
learningObjectives: Pass 1 — watch or read for intuition, and accept the confusion

lessons.title: Learn to say "I don't know, here's how I'd find out" and to change your mind publicly
learningObjectives: Pass 1 — watch or read for intuition, and accept the confusion

lessons.title: Teach: talks, workshops, mentoring. Teaching exposes every gap you have.
learningObjectives: Pass 1 — watch or read for intuition, and accept the confusion

lessons.title: Measure everything you claim. "It's better" is worthless; "it's 23% better on this eval, here's the CI" is a career.
learningObjectives: Pass 1 — watch or read for intuition, and accept the confusion

lessons.title: Develop taste: knowing what not to build is worth more than the ability to build anything.
learningObjectives: Pass 1 — watch or read for intuition, and accept the confusion
